questions.subject: Science
questions.stem:
Neha is putting together a simple instrument at home. She stretches a string tightly across a wooden board and pulls it with her fingers. She then strikes a metal plate with a small wooden stick, and each time she hears a sound.

Assertion 1: A sound is produced when Neha pulls the stretched string, and a sound is also produced when she strikes the metal plate.
Reason 2: Pulling a stretched string or striking a metal object makes them vibrate, which produces sound.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer. (A) Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are true and Reason 2 is the correct explanation of Assertion 1. (B) Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are true but Reason 2 is not the correct explanation of Assertion 1. (C) Assertion 1 is true but Reason 2 is false. (D) Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are true and Reason 2 is the correct explanation of Assertion 1.

evidence:
Pulling a stretched string or striking a metal object makes them vibrate,
which produces sound.

Sound can be produced by vibrating strings membranes, air
columns, and many other vibrating objects.
Vibration refers to the periodic to and fro motion (oscillations) of an object.

options.A: Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are true and Reason 2 is the correct explanation of Assertion 1.
options.B: Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are true but Reason 2 is not the correct explanation of Assertion 1.
options.C: Assertion 1 is true but Reason 2 is false.
options.D: Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are false.

questions.subject: Science
questions.stem:
On a summer evening Rohit hears a sharp, sustained sound coming from a field where grasshoppers and crickets are moving about, and he wonders how these insects make a sound at all.

Assertion 1: Grasshoppers and crickets produce sound by rubbing their wings or their legs.
Reason 2: The sound of these insects is produced by the vibration of their vocal cords, which are tightly stretched muscular flaps located inside the voice box or larynx.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer. (A) Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are true and Reason 2 is the correct explanation of Assertion 1. (B) Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are true but Reason 2 is not the correct explanation of Assertion 1. (C) Assertion 1 is true but Reason 2 is false. (D) Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Assertion 1 is true but Reason 2 is false.

questions.subject: Science
questions.stem:
Ravi is comparing the way in which different musical instruments make their sound, and he is surprised at how many different kinds of vibrating parts a single instrument can have.

Assertion 1: In most musical instruments, sound is produced by the vibration of only one part.
Reason 2: Vibrating strings and vibrating air columns are the only objects capable of producing sound.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer. (A) Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are true and Reason 2 is the correct explanation of Assertion 1. (B) Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are true but Reason 2 is not the correct explanation of Assertion 1. (C) Assertion 1 is true but Reason 2 is false. (D) Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both Assertion 1 and Reason 2 are false.

evidence:
Sound can be produced by vibrating strings membranes, air
columns, and many other vibrating objects.

In most musical instruments,
more than one vibrating part is involved in producing sound.
